def checkIn (t : Traveler) : Traveler := solution!( match t with | .ticketed bagContent => .checkedIn bagContent .notScreened | _ => t ) theorem checkIn_test1 : checkIn (.noTicket .ordinary) = .noTicket .ordinary := solution!(⊢ checkIn (Traveler.noTicket BagContent.ordinary) = Traveler.noTicket BagContent.ordinary All goals completed! 🐙) theorem checkIn_test2 : checkIn (.ticketed .prohibited) = .checkedIn .prohibited .notScreened := solution!(⊢ checkIn (Traveler.ticketed BagContent.prohibited) = Traveler.checkedIn BagContent.prohibited ScreeningStatus.notScreened All goals completed! 🐙) theorem checkIn_test3 : checkIn (.checkedIn .ordinary .cleared) = .checkedIn .ordinary .cleared := solution!(⊢ checkIn (Traveler.checkedIn BagContent.ordinary ScreeningStatus.cleared) = Traveler.checkedIn BagContent.ordinary ScreeningStatus.cleared All goals completed! 🐙)

Again, we record one rewrite rule for each case:

theorem checkIn_noTicket (bagContent : BagContent) : checkIn (.noTicket bagContent) = .noTicket bagContent := solution!(bagContent:BagContent⊢ checkIn (Traveler.noTicket bagContent) = Traveler.noTicket bagContent All goals completed! 🐙) theorem checkIn_ticketed (bagContent : BagContent) : checkIn (.ticketed bagContent) = .checkedIn bagContent .notScreened := solution!(bagContent:BagContent⊢ checkIn (Traveler.ticketed bagContent) = Traveler.checkedIn bagContent ScreeningStatus.notScreened All goals completed! 🐙) theorem checkIn_checkedIn (bagContent : BagContent) (screeningStatus : ScreeningStatus) : checkIn (.checkedIn bagContent screeningStatus) = .checkedIn bagContent screeningStatus := solution!(bagContent:BagContentscreeningStatus:ScreeningStatus⊢ checkIn (Traveler.checkedIn bagContent screeningStatus) = Traveler.checkedIn bagContent screeningStatus All goals completed! 🐙) attribute [irreducible] checkIn

A traveler who does not yet have a ticket can buy one and then check in. After this, the traveler is checked in and their carry-on bag needs to be screened.

Exercise★(buyTicket_then_checkIn)
theorem buyTicket_then_checkIn (bagContent : BagContent) : checkIn (buyTicket (.noTicket bagContent)) = .checkedIn bagContent .notScreened := bagContent:BagContent⊢ checkIn (buyTicket (Traveler.noTicket bagContent)) = Traveler.checkedIn bagContent ScreeningStatus.notScreened solution! bagContent:BagContent⊢ checkIn (Traveler.ticketed bagContent) = Traveler.checkedIn bagContent ScreeningStatus.notScreened bagContent:BagContent⊢ Traveler.checkedIn bagContent ScreeningStatus.notScreened = Traveler.checkedIn bagContent ScreeningStatus.notScreened All goals completed! 🐙

Carry-on inspection happens only after check-in. A bag containing only ordinary items is cleared, while a bag containing a prohibited item is blocked. If the traveler has not checked in, inspectBag does nothing.

Exercise★(inspectBag)

Define inspectBag.

def inspectBag (t : Traveler) : Traveler := solution!( match t with | .checkedIn .ordinary _ => .checkedIn .ordinary .cleared | .checkedIn .prohibited _ => .checkedIn .prohibited .blocked | _ => t ) theorem inspectBag_test1 : inspectBag (.ticketed .prohibited) = .ticketed .prohibited := solution!(⊢ inspectBag (Traveler.ticketed BagContent.prohibited) = Traveler.ticketed BagContent.prohibited All goals completed! 🐙) theorem inspectBag_test2 : inspectBag (.checkedIn .ordinary .notScreened) = .checkedIn .ordinary .cleared := solution!(⊢ inspectBag (Traveler.checkedIn BagContent.ordinary ScreeningStatus.notScreened) = Traveler.checkedIn BagContent.ordinary ScreeningStatus.cleared All goals completed! 🐙) theorem inspectBag_test3 : inspectBag (.checkedIn .prohibited .notScreened) = .checkedIn .prohibited .blocked := solution!(⊢ inspectBag (Traveler.checkedIn BagContent.prohibited ScreeningStatus.notScreened) = Traveler.checkedIn BagContent.prohibited ScreeningStatus.blocked All goals completed! 🐙)

Again, we record one characterization lemma for each case.

theorem inspectBag_noTicket (bagContent : BagContent) : inspectBag (.noTicket bagContent) = .noTicket bagContent := solution!(bagContent:BagContent⊢ inspectBag (Traveler.noTicket bagContent) = Traveler.noTicket bagContent All goals completed! 🐙) theorem inspectBag_ticketed (bagContent : BagContent) : inspectBag (.ticketed bagContent) = .ticketed bagContent := solution!(bagContent:BagContent⊢ inspectBag (Traveler.ticketed bagContent) = Traveler.ticketed bagContent All goals completed! 🐙) theorem inspectBag_ordinary (screeningStatus : ScreeningStatus) : inspectBag (.checkedIn .ordinary screeningStatus) = .checkedIn .ordinary .cleared := solution!(screeningStatus:ScreeningStatus⊢ inspectBag (Traveler.checkedIn BagContent.ordinary screeningStatus) = Traveler.checkedIn BagContent.ordinary ScreeningStatus.cleared All goals completed! 🐙) theorem inspectBag_prohibited (screeningStatus : ScreeningStatus) : inspectBag (.checkedIn .prohibited screeningStatus) = .checkedIn .prohibited .blocked := solution!(screeningStatus:ScreeningStatus⊢ inspectBag (Traveler.checkedIn BagContent.prohibited screeningStatus) = Traveler.checkedIn BagContent.prohibited ScreeningStatus.blocked All goals completed! 🐙) attribute [irreducible] inspectBag
Exercise★★(inspectBag_idempotent)

Show that inspecting the same unchanged carry-on bag twice has the same effect as inspecting it once.

theorem inspectBag_idempotent (t : Traveler) : inspectBag (inspectBag t) = inspectBag t := t:Traveler⊢ inspectBag (inspectBag t) = inspectBag t solution! cases t with bagContent:BagContent⊢ inspectBag (inspectBag (Traveler.noTicket bagContent)) = inspectBag (Traveler.noTicket bagContent) bagContent:BagContent⊢ inspectBag (Traveler.noTicket bagContent) = Traveler.noTicket bagContent bagContent:BagContent⊢ Traveler.noTicket bagContent = Traveler.noTicket bagContent All goals completed! 🐙 bagContent:BagContent⊢ inspectBag (inspectBag (Traveler.ticketed bagContent)) = inspectBag (Traveler.ticketed bagContent) bagContent:BagContent⊢ inspectBag (Traveler.ticketed bagContent) = Traveler.ticketed bagContent bagContent:BagContent⊢ Traveler.ticketed bagContent = Traveler.ticketed bagContent All goals completed! 🐙 bagContent:BagContentscreeningStatus:ScreeningStatus⊢ inspectBag (inspectBag (Traveler.checkedIn bagContent screeningStatus)) = inspectBag (Traveler.checkedIn bagContent screeningStatus) cases bagContent with screeningStatus:ScreeningStatus⊢ inspectBag (inspectBag (Traveler.checkedIn BagContent.prohibited screeningStatus)) = inspectBag (Traveler.checkedIn BagContent.prohibited screeningStatus) screeningStatus:ScreeningStatus⊢ inspectBag (Traveler.checkedIn BagContent.prohibited ScreeningStatus.blocked) = Traveler.checkedIn BagContent.prohibited ScreeningStatus.blocked screeningStatus:ScreeningStatus⊢ Traveler.checkedIn BagContent.prohibited ScreeningStatus.blocked = Traveler.checkedIn BagContent.prohibited ScreeningStatus.blocked All goals completed! 🐙 screeningStatus:ScreeningStatus⊢ inspectBag (inspectBag (Traveler.checkedIn BagContent.ordinary screeningStatus)) = inspectBag (Traveler.checkedIn BagContent.ordinary screeningStatus) screeningStatus:ScreeningStatus⊢ inspectBag (Traveler.checkedIn BagContent.ordinary ScreeningStatus.cleared) = Traveler.checkedIn BagContent.ordinary ScreeningStatus.cleared screeningStatus:ScreeningStatus⊢ Traveler.checkedIn BagContent.ordinary ScreeningStatus.cleared = Traveler.checkedIn BagContent.ordinary ScreeningStatus.cleared All goals completed! 🐙

A traveler may leave the screened area and return with a different carry-on bag. Since the previous screening result applied to the old bag, a new carry-on must be screened again before the traveler can re-enter.

Exercise★(changeBag)

Define changeBag.

def changeBag (newContent : BagContent) (t : Traveler) : Traveler := solution!( match t with | .checkedIn _ _ => .checkedIn newContent .notScreened | .ticketed _ => .ticketed newContent | .noTicket _ => .noTicket newContent ) theorem changeBag_test1 : changeBag .prohibited (.ticketed .ordinary) = .ticketed .prohibited := solution!(⊢ changeBag BagContent.prohibited (Traveler.ticketed BagContent.ordinary) = Traveler.ticketed BagContent.prohibited All goals completed! 🐙) theorem changeBag_test2 : changeBag .prohibited (.checkedIn .ordinary .cleared) = .checkedIn .prohibited .notScreened := solution!(⊢ changeBag BagContent.prohibited (Traveler.checkedIn BagContent.ordinary ScreeningStatus.cleared) = Traveler.checkedIn BagContent.prohibited ScreeningStatus.notScreened All goals completed! 🐙)

As before, we record the behavior of each case as a rewrite rule.

theorem changeBag_noTicket (newContent oldContent : BagContent) : changeBag newContent (.noTicket oldContent) = .noTicket newContent := solution!(newContent:BagContentoldContent:BagContent⊢ changeBag newContent (Traveler.noTicket oldContent) = Traveler.noTicket newContent All goals completed! 🐙) theorem changeBag_ticketed (newContent oldContent : BagContent) : changeBag newContent (.ticketed oldContent) = .ticketed newContent := solution!(newContent:BagContentoldContent:BagContent⊢ changeBag newContent (Traveler.ticketed oldContent) = Traveler.ticketed newContent All goals completed! 🐙) theorem changeBag_checkedIn (newContent oldContent : BagContent) (screeningStatus : ScreeningStatus) : changeBag newContent (.checkedIn oldContent screeningStatus) = .checkedIn newContent .notScreened := solution!(newContent:BagContentoldContent:BagContentscreeningStatus:ScreeningStatus⊢ changeBag newContent (Traveler.checkedIn oldContent screeningStatus) = Traveler.checkedIn newContent ScreeningStatus.notScreened All goals completed! 🐙) attribute [irreducible] changeBag

It is easy to see that replacing a bag after it has been inspected resets its screening status. In other words, inspectBag and changeBag do not, in general, commute: the order in which the two operations are performed can affect the result.

However, if the traveler has not checked in, inspectBag does nothing, so changing and inspecting the carry-on can be performed in either order. There are two such cases: the traveler may not yet have a ticket, or may have a ticket but not yet be checked in.

Exercise★★(inspectBag_changeBag_comm)
theorem inspectBag_changeBag_comm_noTicket (oldContent newContent : BagContent) : inspectBag (changeBag newContent (.noTicket oldContent)) = changeBag newContent (inspectBag (.noTicket oldContent)) := oldContent:BagContentnewContent:BagContent⊢ inspectBag (changeBag newContent (Traveler.noTicket oldContent)) = changeBag newContent (inspectBag (Traveler.noTicket oldContent)) solution! oldContent:BagContentnewContent:BagContent⊢ inspectBag (Traveler.noTicket newContent) = changeBag newContent (inspectBag (Traveler.noTicket oldContent)) oldContent:BagContentnewContent:BagContent⊢ Traveler.noTicket newContent = changeBag newContent (inspectBag (Traveler.noTicket oldContent)) oldContent:BagContentnewContent:BagContent⊢ Traveler.noTicket newContent = changeBag newContent (Traveler.noTicket oldContent) oldContent:BagContentnewContent:BagContent⊢ Traveler.noTicket newContent = Traveler.noTicket newContent All goals completed! 🐙 theorem inspectBag_changeBag_comm_ticketed (oldContent newContent : BagContent) : inspectBag (changeBag newContent (.ticketed oldContent)) = changeBag newContent (inspectBag (.ticketed oldContent)) := oldContent:BagContentnewContent:BagContent⊢ inspectBag (changeBag newContent (Traveler.ticketed oldContent)) = changeBag newContent (inspectBag (Traveler.ticketed oldContent)) solution! oldContent:BagContentnewContent:BagContent⊢ inspectBag (Traveler.ticketed newContent) = changeBag newContent (inspectBag (Traveler.ticketed oldContent)) oldContent:BagContentnewContent:BagContent⊢ Traveler.ticketed newContent = changeBag newContent (inspectBag (Traveler.ticketed oldContent)) oldContent:BagContentnewContent:BagContent⊢ Traveler.ticketed newContent = changeBag newContent (Traveler.ticketed oldContent) oldContent:BagContentnewContent:BagContent⊢ Traveler.ticketed newContent = Traveler.ticketed newContent All goals completed! 🐙
